title: Plot Twisted: Gaming Edition
tagline: Name the game from one painfully bad description.
description: Retro cartridge trivia. Five stages, three lives and a boss, all built on clues that are accurate in the worst possible way.
longDescription: Plot Twisted: Gaming Edition turns the last 25 to 30 years of video games into deliberately unhelpful one-liners. Clear five stages and a boss on three lives. Typing 'Sonic' counts for Sonic the Hedgehog, because recognition is the whole point.
role: Concept, writing, clue system, UI and development
challenge: Write hundreds of clues that are funny without becoming impossible, then grade answers the way a friend would.
solution: A 300+ clue library, recognition-first answer matching that accepts franchise shorthand when only one answer fits, and a cartridge look with stages, lives and a boss round.
next: Up next: more clues, better streak feedback and themed challenge packs.
